verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a SaaS code-hosting platform like Bitbucket, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out. The SOC2/ISO/GDPR compliance and encryption claims are adjacent security and compliance features, not an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
